This is a drastic shift and represents a major red flag. The loss significantly outweighs any marginal improvements in other areas.

The decrease in assets, decline in sales, significant net loss, and increased debt-to-equity ratio create a negative outlook. The substantial loss makes it difficult to overlook the underlying financial difficulties, therefore pushing the sentiment score significantly negative.
